about.title: About UZUZ
about.intro: UZUZ is a free, original live-quiz platform built for Uzbekistan and beyond. Open the site, pick a nickname, and play — in Uzbek, Russian or English.

points.title: No barriers
points.text: No accounts, no email, no payments. Everything is free and stays free.

points.title: Real multiplayer
points.text: Synchronized questions and timers. Scores are calculated on the server, so nobody can cheat their way to the top.

points.title: Teams
points.text: Find people who share your subject, language and level, or start your own team in seconds.

points.title: Make your own
points.text: Create quizzes with images and explanations, share a link, and edit later with your private edit key.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: UZUZ is built to collect as little as possible. Here is exactly what is stored.

sections.title: Guest session
sections.text: On your first visit the server creates a random guest session and stores it in a secure, httpOnly cookie. We keep only a hashed version of that token. It expires 30 days after your last visit.

sections.title: What we store
sections.text: Your nickname, avatar choice, game results, XP and badges, teams you joined and quizzes you published. We never ask for your name, email, phone or payment details.

sections.title: In your browser
sections.text: Language, theme, sound and motion settings, favorites, quiz drafts and edit keys are kept in your browser’s local storage. Clearing browser data removes them.

sections.title: Public information
sections.text: Nicknames appear in game rooms, team pages and rankings. You can hide yourself from public rankings on the My results page.

sections.title: Moderation
sections.text: Reports are reviewed by moderators who can hide quizzes, teams or offensive nicknames.
